scenario.description: Owen owns a portable telescope and must decide whether to rent it informally to Leah for a meteor-shower outing, settling the rental terms, viewing accessories, pickup, and transport conditions after checking with the interested renter and three people familiar with the outing.

shared_context.S1: Owen has one portable 8-inch Dobsonian telescope available for an informal rental during the upcoming meteor-shower weekend.
shared_context.S2: Leah has asked about borrowing the telescope, and Owen makes the final decision about whether to rent it and on what terms.
shared_context.S3: The telescope is stored in Owen's covered front porch and must be collected and returned there.
shared_context.S4: Owen's usual practice for an informal rental is to review the proposed terms with the people involved before recording them and making the final call.
shared_context.S5: Owen has a padded case suitable for transporting the telescope and can provide it with the rental.
shared_context.S6: As part of Owen's usual review, each participant puts any relevant proposal or advice into the meeting record as a separate recorded item before Owen records the final terms.

PF1.text: Leah's exact proposal is to pay $35, leave a $100 cash deposit, collect the telescope Friday at 18:00, and return it Saturday at 10:00.

PF2.text: Ravi checked the local astronomy club's observing guide, which says the meteor shower's useful viewing window is Saturday from 00:30 to 04:00; this has not been shared with Owen.

PF3.text: Marta saw the town notice that the street in front of Owen's house will close at 18:30 Friday for resurfacing, so collection must be completed by 18:30; she has not mentioned the notice yet.

PF4.text: Jonas has used this telescope model and says it must be transported upright in its padded case, with the optical tube secured separately from the base; he has not told Owen this yet.

acceptance_conditions: Leah must be selected as the renter.
The rental fee must be exactly $35.
The deposit must be exactly $100 in cash.
Collection must be scheduled for a Friday time at or before 18:30, and return for Saturday at 10:00.
The agreement must cover the useful viewing window of Saturday 00:30-04:00.
Collection must be scheduled by the 18:30 Friday street closure.
The telescope must be transported upright in its padded case with the optical tube and base secured separately.
The resurfacing notice must be cited as the reason for the collection deadline.

content_checks.C3: 'Friday 18:00' in decisions['collection_time'] and ('18:30' in decisions['collection_time'] or any('18:30' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))
content_checks.C6: decisions['collection_time'] in ['Friday at 18:00', 'Friday 18:00', 'Friday at 17:30', 'Friday 17:30', 'Friday at 17:00', 'Friday 17:00', 'Friday at 5:45 PM', 'Friday 5:45 PM', 'Friday at 5:30 PM', 'Friday 5:30 PM', 'Friday at 5:00 PM', 'Friday 5:00 PM'] or any('18:30' in c['detail'] or '6:30 PM' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Leah's exact proposal sets the renter, $35 fee, $100 cash deposit, Friday 18:00 pickup, and Saturday 10:00 return instead of leaving those settlement terms unknown.
The astronomy club's timing identifies the exact Saturday 00:30-04:00 viewing window that the rental must cover rather than an arbitrary overnight period.
The resurfacing notice changes collection from an unrestricted porch pickup to a commitment completed by 18:30 Friday and supplies the fact Owen must cite.
The model-specific handling advice changes transport from unspecified carrying to upright movement in a padded case with the optical tube and base secured separately.
